customManagers.description: Tool Versions in role defaults, each driven by its own `# renovate:` annotation
App Versions declared as typed `version:` blocks in Playbook Meta (ADR-0017)

packageRules.description: `build` so release-plz cuts a release (ADR-0017). Must live in a packageRule: config:recommended pulls in :semanticPrefixFixDepsChoreOthers, whose own packageRules override any top-level semanticCommitType.
hermes_uv_version and tgtg_uv_version are the same dep and must move together

headscale refuses to start when a deploy skips a minor: upstream enforces a strict upgrade path (juanfont/headscale#3083) because it deletes old DB migrations each minor (0.28.0 dropped pre-0.25, 0.29.0 dropped pre-0.28). One PR per minor stream yields the required ladder instead of a single multi-minor jump. Merge them one rung at a time — the option separates the PRs but does not serialize them, and `separateMultipleMinor` is experimental in Renovate.
grimmory is auberge's own build output (build-grimmory.yml), not a dependency

Temurin GA respins bump a 4th digit (25.0.4+7 then 25.0.4.1+1) and default semver-coerced discards everything past the patch, so the respins — the security releases — would never be offered. This regex ranks the 4th digit as build and the +suffix as revision (compared only when build exists, which GA ordering never needs). Blind by design: same-x.y.z +build-only re-releases (GA never ships those) and the initial `25+36` GA shape (a new major is a manual depName edit — the per-major repo is what makes LTS-only structural, ADR-0030). Lives here, not in the `# renovate:` annotation, because the pattern breaches yaml line-length.
